received_works.body:
Dear Souku Ryu Kaya, My name is Unikross and I would like to thank you for your help.
Thank you very much for your wonderful illustrations in the past!
I was very, very happy to have it as a standby for all of us to enjoy.
I would like to ask you to draw another OC with my friend.
If there are any problems with both the price and the request, please cancel or resend.

The request is for two people who are in a peaceful everyday life together.
We would like to have an illustration of two people in their daily lives, spending time together peacefully, or engaging in loverly activities.
I will leave NSFW enabled, so I would appreciate it if you could draw it as you like.
These two are OC created in a TRPG.
You are free to do whatever you like in terms of composition and clothing.
The relationship between them is A and B.
I will be very happy if A has a dominant and sadistic expression on her face!
We are lovers in a master-slave relationship, so we would be happy if we can see that kind of atmosphere.

I would be very happy if you could see the dominant and sadistic expression on A's face.
I would like to use it as wallpaper or icon for my and my partner's SNS or discord.
When you draw a picture, you can post it on SNS with the URL when you report the drawing.
For personal viewing and non-commercial merchandising for you and your partner.
Any of the above that are not for personal use.

They are very precious to us, and we would be very grateful if we could have a chance to work with them.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1W4DG8De4dI444dxEwx_SKiUKluhuMTvv?hl=ja

Hi Souku Ryu Kaya Sensei, nice to meet you.
I came here from Misskey.
I would like to make a request because I think the handsome man you draw is cool.
I would like you to draw Mr. Murakami, the manager of Misskey.io, in a Santa costume handing out presents.
I would be even more grateful if you could include the words "Merry Christmas" in the dialogue.
I will leave the composition and situation to you.
Thank you in advance.

I saw Mr. Souku Ryu Kaya's drawings on misskey. I saw her drawings on misskey and thought that she is capable of drawing delicate and beautiful pictures, so I requested her to draw one for me. I am not concerned about the composition of the illustration, so please draw an illustration that you think is beautiful with her black hair piled up.

Hello, my name is Unikross.
I would like to contact Mr. Souku Ryu Kaya to make a request.
I would like you to draw the four people in ABCD shown here.
If there are any problems with the amount of money, please feel free to resend it to me.

Regarding the relationship
The relationship between A and B is that of lovers, junior and senior.
The relationship between C and D is unclear and has not yet developed into a romance. They are very important to each other.
They are also juniors and seniors.
They are university students who belong to an occult circle and get along very well with each other, going on trips, etc.

A tends to be naughty, hugging, biting and kissing B at every opportunity.
B tries to avoid A, but when he gets close to A, he turns red and tries to run away, but it ends in vain.
C values D more than others.
D is important to all of us, but I feel that C is somewhat special....
I would be happy if the atmosphere is something like this.
I have set the NSFW for now, but I would appreciate it if you could draw it as you like, Aoikuryu Kaya.
Thank you very much.

I would like to use it for the following purposes.
I would like to use it as a wallpaper or icon on SNS or discord for myself and my partner.
We would like to use your drawings on our SNS and discord for our own and other people's wallpaper and icons.
To be made into goods for personal viewing and non-commercial use for you and your partner.
Any of the above that are not for personal use.

We are four irreplaceable friends, and we look forward to working with you.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1ppNWPtyBCu3Fa6Fha0g_6NwjTQAHrokT

This may be an illustration or a very unusual request, but it is a request to create an elementary body illustration based on your understanding of the structure of the human body as seen in your drawings and the fact that you are a lecturer.
I am having trouble understanding the connection between the neck, head, and shoulders in particular when drawing the human figure, and since I fundamentally dislike humans, I am sick and tired of observing them and have trouble doing it properly. I am having trouble observing people properly because I fundamentally dislike them. I thought I might be able to remember if I refer to illustrations of my favorite types.
Requirements for creation
I would like to use a boy around 14 years old as a model.
The illustration should be above the shoulders.
The connection between the neck, head, and shoulders should be clear.
I would like you to use your illustration, not a realistic one.
We would like you to draw several illustrations.
For example, I can see the front view, but I would like you to draw an illustration that shows the position of the neck when the shoulders are slanted, the bend of the neck and the position of the face when the neck is swung to the left or right, and the position of the face when the head is turned to the right or left while facing straight ahead, so that I can compare it with the normal state.
As an aside, I prefer a simple boy like villager A to a beautiful boy.
Thank you in advance.

Hello. Thank you for the bunny boy project the other day.
I really liked the man drawn by Souku Ryukaya, so I sent him a request.

The contents of the request are as follows
I would like an illustration of our original character "Danas" (please refer to the section "Danas-Akatic" in the resource URL) and an inverted character of Danas fighting each other, or rather, a composition of Danas resisting being attacked by the inverted character.

Relationship between the two
The main body Danas: does not want to acknowledge the existence of the inverted Danas and does not want to look directly at him. The rejection is the first step.
Inverted Danas: The embodiment of Danas' subconscious immoral side. He has a one-sided, obsessive (even abusive) fondness for the main body Danas, and wants to take it in.
I don't have any data on the inverted character, but I imagine the same face but opposite in color and personality, with inverted eyes. (For your information, Danas is calm and quiet, and the inverted character is nervous and aggressive.)

Purpose of use
Personal viewing and posting on SNS (io's account)

This is a request for two illustrations, so if the price is not reasonable, I would appreciate it if you could resend the request.
We apologize for the fluffiness of this request, but we would appreciate your consideration.
Thank you very much.

https://misskey.io/@kyoka_h/pages/1717201985095

It is nice to meet you. I saw your picture on misskey, and I like your style and design so much that I decided to commission you to draw one.

The character I would like to request this time is Taihei's Taihei-chan,
I have often been commissioned to draw her myself, even though she is a child of another artist. (Of course, I have the approval of the artist.)

She has large breasts, cat ears, and a cool personality.
If you can specify the pose, I would like her to be sitting on the floor (on her knees) smoking a cigarette.
He should be hatless, and if possible, the gun should be propped up against the wall.

I always enjoy looking at your wonderful illustrations.
I really love your illustrations and would like to request you to draw a character of my creation.
I would appreciate it if you could refer to the links to the illustrations of my original characters in the URL below.

The character I have in mind is a world-traveling jeweler who enjoys meeting various people in the city. He does some mining himself, so his body is muscular, but when the time comes, his weapon of choice is a jeweled staff boosted by magic. Blue is her image color.
(I only wrote this for reference of composition and facial expression, so you don't have to follow the setting. You can also rearrange the clothes and other details to make it easier to draw.)

If possible, I would like to use it as a background for my iPad, so I would be happy if the image size is about 3:4 (height:width).

Thank you in advance.

Nice to meet you.
I saw your advertisement note and thought it was a nice pattern, so I made a request.
I would be happy if you could draw any of the characters in the following URL if you can find one that is easy to draw. (This is my original character.)

We would appreciate your consideration.
